verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm cubic serves an llms.txt index at docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt and Markdown versions of its doc pages. Each .md page tells agents to fetch the full documentation index from llms.txt, and many .md doc URLs appear in the pack. cubic also ships agent-oriented material: skills that give coding agents instructions (cubic-docs-17) and an MCP server agents can use to look up codebase documentation (cubic-docs-72). missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and no first-party guide explaining how to point agents at these docs.
